verdict.rationale: Stripe docs mention that stablecoin payments are supported over the x402 protocol for machine/agent-initiated payments with a minimum of 0.01 USDC (stripe-crypto-docs-16/17), which is the closest evidence to an agent-initiated stablecoin payment flow. However, there is no documentation of human-configured spend controls, scoped authority, or limits governing what an agent can do with stablecoins — the evidence pack only shows the machine-payments protocol existing, not a spend-control mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit spend-control/authority-scoping docs for agent-initiated stablecoin transfers, any UI/API for humans to set agent spend limits, and independent confirmation the x402 flow is used for agent payouts.
